description: Dual attenuator, one channel switchable between attenuating and attenuverting; a channel with nothing patched to its input becomes a manual voltage source

params.text: Sets how much of the A input reaches the A output, and flips its sign when the mode is attenuvert. With A unpatched, the output is a steady voltage set by this knob, up to 10V either way
Switches channel A between attenuating, where the knob runs from silence to full level, and attenuverting, where it runs from full inversion through silence to full level
Sets how much of the B input reaches the B output, from silence to full level. With B unpatched, the output is a steady voltage between 0V and 10V set by this knob

inputs.text: The signal attenuated by the A channel; polyphonic, with every channel scaled by the same amount
The signal attenuated by the B channel; polyphonic, with every channel scaled by the same amount

outputs.text: Carries the A input after the A knob has scaled it; with nothing patched to the A input it carries a steady voltage set by that knob
Carries the B input after the B knob has scaled it; with nothing patched to the B input it carries a steady voltage set by that knob
